endpointName: Bisset Park Boat Ramp / Dudley’s Landing

evidence.stateAccess: Virginia DWR identifies Bisset Park Boat Ramp, also known as Dudley’s Landing, as a New River launch/take-out below the Route 11 bridge.
evidence.cityAccess: The City of Radford lists boat launches at Dudley’s Landing and near Bisset Park and identifies river access at the park.
evidence.projectEvidence: The New River Valley Regional Commission documents a public Bisset Park Shelter #3 boat-access facility with parking and a connecting footpath.
evidence.coordinateFit: The stored point is retained as a park/ramp access-area anchor. The 437-foot flowline offset is facility-placement geometry, while mapped water is 151 ft away and hydrography coverage is complete.
